## Release v8.3.3 — HTML 0.1.38 repair

HTML 0.1.37 generated artifacts omitted distributable asset notices and had a faint blank reflection boundary. This release carries scoped LICENSE/Apache notices, rejects portable output-name collisions before writing, checks installed LICENSE bytes and makes the control boundary visible. The release also carries PR281's bounded Linux browser-startup stderr diagnostics and the intervening synchronization/maintenance records. Guide and the other four plugin trees keep their runtime identities.

This is the release PR under #274, targeting protected `main` from complete actual-develop ancestry (PR283 merge `a4892f51f4163fb5bd4457d99229eaf1a4683e8f`, tree `196daab879d38b649333a01c4c0d0194c7b107c7`). Preparation base is main `e3dc40f734fc972e05956da3e908091e09963675`; public v8.3.2 remains tag/Release `f906b1001a86d7b5415451bd973bea26e6cc3a1d`. VERSION/badge are already 8.3.3; this PR does not bump again. Five packages/eight public skills/five explicit entries remain.

Release head: `cfbeb1bbf3e254ea3b33f5abe9c3eb5207c605a7` / tree `f71963c1d5640933e80fccfec3383681fb15333b`. The independent staged-blob review passed before commit.

### Verification

- Actual283 full local run: 647 total, 646 PASS, zero FAIL and one platform-specific skip. Strict validation and exact CLI 0.147.0 passed.
- Fresh actual283 installation, UTC02:56:38.655–03:09:46.916: 13 scenarios/178 commands all exit0; 6 Diagram and 18 Learning Evidence real Python calls; 4 generated artifacts and 4 static checks, each95/95. Runtime/cache and license bytes matched; all14 unique owned roots were removed and all state guards passed. This is separate from the earlier395 CI and original908 guard FAIL.
- Release documentation candidate: 116/116 documentation/INTENT tests, strict validation and exact CLI baseline passed. 2,295 source bindings include the unchanged original2,079 (including the original1,890); the32-row accepted baseline retains its first five columns. Staged Git blobs receive an independent final closure check before commit.
- The same owner-private Site v2 was deployed successfully from source `3d3082ff8cfa99576bbda816a3ecc3b0b787636d`; owner/custom policy revision1 and audience remained unchanged. Local Chrome155 QA covers320/390/1366 and control screenshots. Hosted full interaction/native matrices were not rerun; local input and native archive descriptors are explicitly distinct in the ledger.
- New release-head server CI, latest base, resolved threads and real non-author/latest-pusher-external approval remain separate gates. AI review does not substitute for GitHub approval; no bypass is authorized.

### First-candidate failures and bounded repair

Head318/tree448 had real failures: both Windows jobs exceeded the unchanged instruction budget (16,317 LF bytes become16,410 CRLF bytes, above16,384); push Ubuntu case330 returned NOT_RUN2 without a DevTools endpoint. PR Ubuntu independently passed647/646P/1skip and its13/178/Python/static95 batch, which does not erase those three failures. The complete204-payload first-CI record is preserved with original bytes. DBus messages do not establish the Linux startup cause; it remains UNKNOWN.

Only the current HTML instruction summary was compressed to the existing task pointer. Actual strict validation now passes against both LF15,903 and CRLF15,996 bytes, with the intended LF restored. No threshold, browser/checker,15-second deadline, workflow or runtime changes were made. Updated documentation116/116 and strict validation pass; new-head server CI was still required at that preparation checkpoint. No same-head rerun API had been used then.

### Current exact-head server verification

Headcfbeb/treef719 now has complete bounded server evidence. Windows executed in PR run39365093169 attempt1 (job118439996188):647/646PASS/0FAIL/1Linux-exec platform skip. Ubuntu first failed at NOT_RUN2/zero viewports with4991-byte complete stderr; that FAIL and UNKNOWN cause remain. After freezing all phase2 originals, one full Ubuntu job was rerun with standard debug logging and no source/checker/flags/deadline/concurrency change. The new Ubuntu job118445089707, attempt2, ran03:54:11–04:00:03Z and passed647/646PASS/0FAIL/1Windows-casing skip. Run attempt2 returned success04:00:04Z. This is one successful new execution, not a root-cause fix or stability claim.

Each actual successful Windows/Ubuntu execution separately completed13 scenarios/178 commands all exit0,6 Diagram/18 Learning Evidence real Python calls and4 generated artifacts/4 static checks each95/95, with CLI0.147.0. Both checked out9a011489e7e1f3aa15505ab32671313132e2d591, treef719 matching the exact head. GitHub's attempt2 Windows proxy IDs retain the original attempt1 execution times; they are not another Windows test. The push workflow only proves the exact PR carrier/source and skips its matrix.

Current Structure/A6 passed. Ready status and real current-head independent approval, threads and latest main base remain separately checked. No review was fabricated, requested from another user or bypassed. Original318 andcfbeb initial failures remain available in the same issue and durable evidence.

### Scope, authorization and retained limits

Original B1/P5 and the five-boundary authorization cover this one repair release and the same private Site repair; the independent scope audit is linked in the [release ledger](docs/runbook/[RUNBOOK]_Marketplace_8_3_3_Release_Readiness.md). No new Owner decision is needed for these authorized technical steps.

The original core acceptance is ACCEPTED_LIMITED and does not accept this new0.1.38/Site v2 or the full plan. Native pending-window lifecycle, native dispatch, the second true client, remaining accessibility/hosted coverage and unmeasured learning effects remain open. Earlier startup/checkout/guard FAIL, UNKNOWN root cause, actual bypass and empty reviews/approval NOT_MET remain recorded. #274 stays open.

### Publication and recovery

Merge only after ordinary protected-main gates pass. VERSION on main invokes the existing draft-first release controls; actual main/tag/Release/run/notes/assets and fresh real-tag installation must then be independently verified. The default install ref stays real v8.3.2 until actual v8.3.3 exists. Stop on failed gates, identity/audience errors, unexpected material or uncertain results. Preserve v8.3.2 and private Site v1; recover with a bounded forward repair or protected new-version repair without rewriting old tags/Release assets.

### Review checklist

- [x] CHANGELOG has an empty Unreleased and complete8.3.3 section;8.3.2 and older Git bytes are preserved.
- [x] Prepared VERSION/badge, exact five-package manifests and installation expectations agree; no second bump.
- [x] Applicable bounded actual checks, isolated installation/Python, independent review,32 baseline rows and source closure are recorded.
- [x] Root AGENTS/A6, canonical guide/spec, task INDEX/unique PLAN/REPORT and release ledger are synchronized;20 repository skills retain their contracts.
- [x] Existing original conditional release authorization is reused; deferrals and old approval gaps are preserved without claiming full plan completion.
- [x] Current release-head CI passed with the actual Windows attempt1 / single Ubuntu attempt2 identities and original failures preserved.
- [ ] Real current-head independent approval, resolved threads and latest main base satisfy protection before ordinary merge.
- [x] No new runtime/debug code beyond the inherited approved repairs; no credentials, unknown-rights research raw or old release overwrites.
